subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the conflicting cross-repo Feishu candidate or open a fresh narrow target-repo fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but the exact open candidate is outside the target repo, conflicting, and previously reviewed as needing safer mention and root-routing behavior.

options.title: Repair Or Replace Candidate
options.body: Use the existing candidate as source context but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait On Cross-Repo Author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the author to rebase and address the prior safety concerns in the open fork PR.

options.title: Defer Feishu Reply Work
options.body: Leave this as an open known bug if Feishu maintenance bandwidth is unavailable, without creating another repair lane yet.

recommendation.title: Repair Or Replace Candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing candidate as source context but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-handling work makes this the closest routing candidate for deciding the safe mention-detection shape.
